review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-03 delegated author, part A2); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-03 part A2: the center's account pages and the WebBrowserSession routes (center/internal/pages: html/template pages, one script and one style sheet embedded in the executable, the /session/v1/web JSON routes and the forms, all calling the API's own handlers in process), the browser channel of the account core (cookie sessions, browser devices and installations, the flow's origin), the Worker's page handler and generated page table (PLT-1), the correlation id the Worker writes into its generated not_activated and rate_limited replies (E4-1), the proof bootstrap (the token script, the two dispatch inputs and the digest and expiry passed through the Worker to the center), the isolated real-browser acceptance package and the A1b registration fixes routed from Cloud #120 (a grace period on the running check; the second receipt lookup only where the first execution may have committed). The Worker sources change (worker/foundation/cloud-container.ts, the ingress pipeline and its new page handler, and the generated center tables). No Go module, base image, toolchain, legal file or migration changes; the page templates and the two static files are embedded by the standard library. It supersedes the A1b admission at cloud-release-r69; the center and Worker sources changed after r69.
